bar-thickness.comment: The thickness of a status band - a progress track, and later a meter. Deliberately DENSITY-INVARIANT: the band carries no text, so nothing else scales with it, and thinning it in compact makes it harder to see for exactly the user who chose compact to fit more on screen. Tier 2 had no size for a small fixed dimension, so a progress track could only be sized from a SPACING token, which density re-tunes as a gap.

round.comment: A circle or a pill. Tier 2 had no alias for radius.full, so no component could legally draw a circle.

family.comment: The single override point PRD F04 AC2 requires: set this one token and every Clara component follows. Clara named no typeface at all until now, which made the 14px body floor, D0037's 24px line-box reservation and D0098's control-height arithmetic assumptions about a face the package never asked for (BG-01M0XN7S).

base.comment: Page content. The scale is measured from here.

raised.comment: In-document chrome that must clear its siblings - a sticky table header, a raised card.

overlay.comment: EVERY portalled surface and its scrim: modal, drawer, popover, menu, listbox. One layer on purpose - which of two overlays is on top depends on which was opened last, and the browser already answers that by DOM order. A per-role constant cannot: a menu must sit under a modal that opens over it, and over a modal opened from inside it.

tooltip.comment: Above every overlay regardless of open order, because a tooltip describes whatever is currently on top and nothing ever opens from INSIDE a tooltip. That relationship is one-directional, which is what makes a constant correct here - D0088's rule stated by its operative property. Deliberately the SAME number as `toast`; see there (D0102).

toast.comment: The same layer as `tooltip`, deliberately, NOT one above it. "Above everything" was false in the one composition where the two meet: a Toast action (Retry, Undo) may carry a tooltip, and that tooltip describes the thing currently on top while rendering under it - the single case where a tooltip is useless, covered by exactly the element it explains. The relationship is bidirectional (a toast arriving over an open tooltip must win; a tooltip opened on a toast's action must win), so open order decides it, not a constant. A toast's guarantee that it is heard does not rest on z-index anyway: it is announced through a live region and an error toast does not auto-dismiss (D0102).

state-change.comment: How long ONE state change takes. One-shot, never repeating. D0094 pre-committed this on enter.

step.comment: How long a repeating indicator takes to advance ONE feature-width. The unit of a cycle, not a cycle.

enter.comment: The curve for a thing arriving. One curve, not a family: Clara exits instantly (D0094), so there is no exit curve to name.
